title: Home Loan Checklist for a Plot or House Near Pondicherry
description: Banks check the property as hard as they check you. A checklist of what lenders look at for plots and houses in and around Pondicherry, before you apply.
h1: Home loan checklist for plot and house purchases near Pondicherry
lead: A loan can fall through after you have paid an advance, usually because of the property rather than the buyer. Check these before you commit.
wa: Hi, I read your guide and have a question about my property in Pondicherry

bullets: Clear, marketable title with an unbroken chain of deeds
Encumbrance certificate with no existing charge
Land use that allows what you plan to build
Valuation that supports the loan amount

paras: Identity, address and income documents, bank statements and tax filings. Lenders differ in what they ask, so check with the bank early, and ask about the rules for a plot loan versus a construction loan.

Many banks do not lend on unapproved layouts. If you plan to finance, confirm the [approval](/guides/dtcp-vs-ppa-approval-pondicherry) first. Our [document check](/buy-property-pondicherry#document-check) is free.
Ask the bank for a legal and technical opinion before paying more than a token advance, and keep the sale agreement conditional on the loan where possible.

blocks.p: Share your budget and we will shortlist only properties a lender is likely to accept.
